thread:
rita: Heads-up folks — final reminder: the Data Privacy refresher and SOC2 evidence packaging deadline is next Monday. Evidence owners must upload artifacts and complete the short quiz. Links: https://learn.redwood.com/courses/data-privacy-refresher and https://confluence.redwood.com/compliance/evidence-packaging

ken: Quick clarify — is the refresher required for all engineers or just evidence owners?

rn: all engineers are asked to take the 15-min refresher, but evidence owners must complete the packaging checklist and quiz. The checklist is on Confluence.

nina: For small teams: can one person take the evidence-owner role for the whole team?

rita: Yes. Pick a primary and a deputy in the attestation form. Make sure the metadata files in S3 list the owner and deputy.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload path is s3://redwood-compliance/attest-2026/<team>/ and metadata files must be named <artifact>-meta.json. Missing metadata will cause auto-flagging.

ken: Any guidance on naming for screenshots of IAM policies?

security-bot: Prefer exported JSON/YAML of the policy. If that's impossible, include a screenshot plus a short text file describing the policy name, owner, and effective date. Redact secrets.

nina: Is there an exception process if a third-party vendor says they can't share certs until their audit completes?

compliance-bot: Exception request template: https://confluence.redwood.com/compliance/exception-template. Include remediation ETA and approver email. Requests missing ETA or approver will be auto-rejected.

rita: I'll pull a verification report Tuesday morning and post results. If your team is flagged, please respond with a plan in-thread or DM me. If you want pairing for packaging, reply here and I'll set up 20 min. Thanks :sparkles:
